name: Curiosity
identity_check: Confirmed as Curiosity Venture Capital B.V. (curiosityvc.com, also styled Curiosity VC), the Amsterdam early-stage AI software investor founded in 2021 by Herman Kienhuis (ex-KPN Ventures) and Maurice Beckand Verwee (Crosspring). Its own post of June 2026 announces the EUR 17M first tranche of Curiosity Fund II for vertical AI, which matches the lead; Vestbee reports the same close and names curiosityvc.com as the firm's site. The Dutch RVO Seed Capital register lists its vehicle Curiosity Seed Fund B.V., managed by Curiosity Venture Capital B.V., at TNW West, Amsterdam, with www.curiosityvc.com as its site. Ruled out: the curiosity.vc domain (connection refused, no link to this firm), a 'Curiosity Partners' listing that surfaced in search (not opened; it does not match the Fund II announcement), and the Curiosity Foundation (curiosityvc.org), the firm's own charitable arm that receives 10% of carried interest, not an investing entity. Also note: the portfolio company 'Utopian Labs' (sales-workflow AI agents, acquired by Zapier) is unrelated to Utopian Autonomy.

thesis_text.value: Amsterdam early-stage fund backing AI-native B2B software founders in the Benelux, Nordics and Baltics, with selective co-investments in London, Berlin and Paris. Fund II concentrates on pre-seed and seed vertical AI companies serving industries such as finance, legal, real estate, energy, manufacturing and cybersecurity. Founders and advisors share in fund profits; 10% of carry goes to its foundation.

open_items: Fund II final close not found as of 2026-10-30. The June 2026 post targets EUR 30-40M with a final close 'later this year'. LPs at first close: 44 private investors plus RVO Seed Capital matching for Dutch investments.

Fund I final size and close date not found. Known: 35 investors committed at launch (Jan 2022), first close April 2022 with 55 LPs (amount undisclosed), EUR 50M target and EUR 75M hard cap (Unquote). Investment Fund Groningen joined as an LP (Curiosity post, Feb 2024; amount not stated).

Curiosity Seed Fund B.V. (RVO register): EZK loan EUR 6M, investment budget EUR 12M, term 2022-2032, investment period 2022-2026, aims to back 10 Dutch software companies, managed by Curiosity Venture Capital B.V. Its relationship to Fund I (probably a parallel vehicle for Dutch deals) is not stated. Whether Fund II has its own RVO vehicle is not stated.
Check size for Fund II not stated; the EUR 500K-1.5M range comes from the Fund I-era RVO vehicle and Unquote 2022.
Nothing found on investing in Indian founders, so that fact is omitted. Nothing found on requiring a US entity; the firm targets companies headquartered in the Benelux, Nordics and Baltics.

Rounds come from Curiosity's own news posts (primary). Independent press was not fetched for most; the CFNEWS Indurex article is paywalled and confirms only a trio of European investors and that the Dutch startup was launched 'last year' by Jalal Bouhdada (so founded probably 2025, not recorded). Indurex's stage is not stated; CFNEWS's wording 's'amorce' suggests a seed round.

Round gaps: amounts not disclosed for Imperum, Lynk and Onesurance. HQ not stated for Dawnguard (dateline New York & Amsterdam), Validfor and Dreamdata (dateline Copenhagen, New York). Dawnguard's website is not linked. In Dawnguard's round the $3.3M came 'from existing investor BNVT Capital', so BNVT is recorded as unspecified rather than lead. Display.dev's post names no lead.

Older rounds on curiosityvc.com/news, not fetched or recorded: Moonlit (Aug 2024), Epum $1.6M pre-seed led (Jul 2024), Neople EUR 6M (Jun 2024), QA.tech (May 2024), Altura EUR 3M seed led (Mar 2024), Orq.ai pre-seed extension to EUR 2.3M (Mar 2024), BeCause $2.5M seed (Feb 2024), Version Lens EUR 1.5M (Jan 2024), Luna.ai (Nov 2023), Orquesta EUR 800K pre-seed led (Oct 2023), Strise $10.8M (Sep 2023), Neople EUR 1.5M (Jun 2023), Deeploy EUR 2.5M seed (Jun 2023), Epicbrief led (Apr 2023), Dreamdata EUR 7M Series A (Mar 2023), Strise EUR 3.3M led (Nov 2022), Freesi (Jun 2022), Alpha AR (Mar 2022), Deeploy EUR 0.8M first investment (Jan 2022).

Exits named by the firm: Nalvin joined Lovable (Jul 2026) and Utopian Labs was acquired by Zapier (Oct 2025). The portfolio page labels every card 'Exit', including companies that raised recently, which looks like a site display quirk rather than real exits.

Team changes: Lisa Brouwer was quoted as Principal at Curiosity (XFA post, Dec 2025) and Elliot Schouten as CFO and investment manager (Lynk post, Dec 2025); neither is on the current core team, and Schouten now appears as an advisor. 'Fleur, AI Analyst' on the team page links only to the company LinkedIn page. Investment Analyst Eva Formica is not recorded as a partner. The team page states no focus areas, so partner focus_sectors are drawn from the deals each founder is quoted on (Kienhuis: Duqu, Orq.ai, Fund II; Beckand Verwee: Imperum).
Sifted, Tech.eu and EU-Startups coverage of the individual 2025-2026 rounds was not searched (search budget spent on fund history).
